answer: A payout is split so that 23% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The sonnet schedule is applied in reef and jade exposes each instalment. An attacker hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2195 identities would post 4473 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
